item.title: Show HN: I made a heatmap of 3400 VCs who are open to cold emails
Xsnow "protestware" in Debian
item.description:
📝 DFSG violation Ivanov claimed that the behavior violated the Debian Free Software Guidelines (DFSG) that are part of the project's Social Contract. Chris Hofstaedtler replied that Ivanov was mistaken; the DFSG does not require that the software is non-discriminatory, but that the license for the software is. Ivanov said that he understood the point that xsnow did not violate the DFSG.
🔗 Read more: https://lwn.net/SubscriberLink/1079385/3d7a57da58b41aa9/
